confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for Bali's Ubud and Canggu tourist areas, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and prices vary a lot between tourist strips and local spots. Beer and cocktail figures are bounded estimates. The FX observation was taken from search-result snippets of RBA pages; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional SEA basis using Indonesian tourist-area price levels for Ubud and Canggu, benchmarked against other Southeast Asian tourist hubs with similar restaurant and guesthouse pricing.
